episode.title: Infinite Fallback Loop on retryable errors (429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED): classify undelayed model-capacity exhaustion as terminal
episode.before: At parent dc859e8e48868ef5d1cc3b6708dbbdf3817cb9c9, the structured quota classifier parsed ErrorInfo and RetryInfo but had no semantic case for model-capacity exhaustion or capacity-exceeded reasons. A detailed 429 with one of those reasons and no parsed RetryInfo delay therefore bypassed the existing daily-limit, credit-balance, Cloud Code, retry-delay, and short-term-limit branches and fell to generic RetryableQuotaError. The retry loop treated that result as transient: it waited and retried, and only consulted the persistent-failure callback at the maximum-attempt boundary, so an exhausted model could be retried before fallback. This is consistent with the issue's retry/fallback hang title. [ev-before-001] [ev-call-002] [ev-issue-001]
episode.after: At d55e366f6ab393e024c613d940fead3696d56eac, after parsing the optional retry delay, the classifier checks the two model-capacity reasons before domain-specific quota handling. When no parsed server delay exists, it returns a terminal quota classification carrying the parsed API error and reason; the retry loop can then invoke onPersistent429 immediately and reset attempts if a fallback model is supplied. When a server delay exists, the new branch falls through, preserving the existing delay-aware retry behavior. [ev-impl-001] [ev-call-001] [ev-test-001]
episode.diff: This is an additive two-file patch: 17 implementation lines in the shared quota classifier and 57 test lines. The implementation adds one conditional guard for MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED and MODEL_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED, terminalizing only the no-delay case while leaving delay-bearing capacity failures to existing RetryInfo processing. The tests cover no-delay exhaustion in the normal domain, no-delay exhaustion in a non-Cloud-Code domain, and no-delay capacity exceeded; the pre-existing 9-second capacity case continues to assert retryable behavior. No retry-loop or call-site file changed. [ev-diff-001] [ev-impl-001] [ev-test-001] [ev-test-002]

evidence_units.claim: Issue 28339 is titled Infinite Fallback Loop on retryable errors (429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED).

The pinned resolved commit is d55e366f6ab393e024c613d940fead3696d56eac, its parent is dc859e8e48868ef5d1cc3b6708dbbdf3817cb9c9, and its subject is fix(core): classify capacity exhaustion as terminal to prevent retry hangs (#28599); the bundle labels the problem category failure-recovery-and-retry.
evidence_units.source: issue-bundle.json: pinned_ref, resolved_commit, parent_commit, commit_show_stat, and manifest_metadata; corroborated by git show d55e366f6ab393e024c613d940fead3696d56eac

evidence_units.claim: The pinned commit changes only packages/core/src/utils/googleQuotaErrors.ts and packages/core/src/utils/googleQuotaErrors.test.ts, adding 17 implementation lines and 57 test lines with no deletions.

In the parent classifier, structured details are extracted into QuotaFailure, ErrorInfo, and RetryInfo. The ErrorInfo logic special-cases insufficient credits and Cloud Code rate/quota reasons, but has no branch for model-capacity exhaustion or capacity exceeded; if no other detailed rule matches, the function returns generic RetryableQuotaError.

The pinned classifier parses retryDelay into delaySeconds, then checks ErrorInfo reasons MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED and MODEL_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED. If delaySeconds is undefined it returns a terminal quota error with the API message, parsed API error, undefined delay, and reason; otherwise it falls through to existing retry-delay and domain handling.

retryWithBackoff calls classifyGoogleError from its catch path. A terminal quota classification invokes onPersistent429 before normal retry processing; if that callback returns a fallback model, the loop resets attempts and delay and retries with the new model, otherwise it throws the terminal classification.

A RetryableQuotaError enters the retry branch. The persistent-failure callback is consulted only after the current maximum attempts is reached, while retryDelayMs controls the server-directed wait and missing delay uses exponential backoff with jitter.

The existing capacity test supplies MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED with RetryInfo retryDelay 9s and asserts RetryableQuotaError with retryDelayMs equal to 9000, documenting that a server-directed delay preserves retryable behavior.

The commit adds three classifier tests: MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED with no retry delay in the Cloud Code domain, the same reason with a non-Cloud-Code domain, and MODEL_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED with no retry delay; each asserts TerminalQuotaError.

The checked-out workspace has no root node_modules/.bin/vitest, so the focused Vitest suite was not executed during extraction; the available validation oracle is the checked-in regression-test code plus the clean diff inspection.

candidate_atomics.name: classify-undelayed-model-capacity-exhaustion-as-terminal
candidate_atomics.description: Add a classifier rule that maps structured model-capacity exhaustion with no server delay to terminal handling, while preserving retryable handling for capacity failures that carry a server delay.

semantic_action.intent: Stop retrying an exhausted model when the upstream supplies no retry schedule, so persistent fallback handling can be reached.
semantic_action.module_role: Structured upstream-failure classifier at the retry and fallback boundary
semantic_action.pre_state: A structured quota failure is recognized as a retryable-status error, but its capacity-exhaustion reason is not distinguished and no parsed server retry delay is available; it falls through to generic transient handling.
semantic_action.post_state: The no-delay capacity-exhaustion condition is classified as terminal and retains the parsed error and reason for downstream fallback handling; a present server delay takes the existing retryable, delay-aware path.
semantic_action.validation: The added focused tests assert terminal classification for both capacity-reason variants with no delay, including a non-Cloud-Code domain, while the existing 9-second RetryInfo case asserts retryable classification with a 9000 ms delay. The assertions were not executed in this checkout because the Vitest binary is absent.
parameters: parsed API error payload and details

candidate_workflows.name: classify-capacity-exhaustion-before-retry
candidate_workflows.description: When a structured model-capacity failure lacks a server-directed delay, classify it as terminal at the error-normalization boundary so persistent fallback handling is reached without normal retry churn; retain delay-based retry for explicitly delayed capacity failures.

workflow_graph.goal: Route a no-delay model-capacity failure to terminal and fallback handling without retrying the same exhausted model through the normal transient path.
workflow_graph.entry_state: A detailed retryable-status API error reaches classification with a model-capacity exhaustion reason and no parsed server retry delay.
workflow_graph.exit_state: Capacity exhaustion without a server delay is terminal and eligible for immediate persistent fallback; capacity errors with a server delay remain delay-aware retryable failures.
